description: This file contains Redux action creators for managing product-related state in a React/Redux e-commerce application. It includes actions for fetching, adding, updating, deleting, and filtering products, as well as handling form changes and loading states.

methods.name: productChange
methods.description: Creates an action to update a product form field with a new value.

methods.name: productEditChange
methods.description: Creates an action to update a product edit form field with a new value.

methods.name: productShopChange
methods.description: Creates an action to update a product shop-related form field with a new value.

methods.name: resetProduct
methods.description: Dispatches an action to reset the product state to its initial value.

methods.name: setProductLoading
methods.description: Dispatches an action to set the loading state for product-related operations.

methods.name: filterProducts2
methods.description: Updates advanced product filters in the state based on a filter change.

methods.name: filterProducts
methods.description: Fetches filtered product list from the API based on current filters and sorting.

methods.name: fetchStoreProduct
methods.description: Fetches a single product by slug from the API and updates the store.

methods.name: fetchProductsSelect
methods.description: Fetches a list of products formatted for select options.

methods.name: fetchProducts
methods.description: Fetches the list of all products from the API.

methods.name: fetchProduct
methods.description: Fetches detailed information for a single product by ID.

methods.name: addProduct
methods.description: Validates and submits a new product to the API, then updates the store.

methods.name: updateProduct
methods.description: Validates and updates an existing product via the API.

methods.name: activateProduct
methods.description: Activates or deactivates a product via the API.

methods.name: deleteProduct
methods.description: Deletes a product via the API and updates the store.
